summary_1line: Arjuna stuns the Kuru army with the Sanmohana weapon, humiliates Duryodhana, spares surrendered soldiers, and returns the recovered cattle to Virata.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands on his chariot blowing the conch Devadatta while the Kuru warriors around him drop their bows and stand stunned.
Uttara runs among the unconscious Kuru heroes on the battlefield, gathering their brightly colored garments as Arjuna watches from the chariot.
With a precise arrow, Arjuna shatters the jewel-studded crown of Duryodhana while saluting the elders on the battlefield.
